headline: Airbnb to launch AI travel-planning agent in 2027
summary: Airbnb announced, in its Q3 2026 earnings letter, that it is developing an AI travel agent due in the first half of 2027 to help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings and get assistance during their stay, going beyond today's simpler AI agents.

claims.statement: Airbnb announced it is developing an AI travel agent planned to launch in the first half of 2027.

sources.quote: Airbnb says it’s launching an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027
Airbnb plans to roll out an AI agent in the first half of 2027 that will help users plan and book travel

claims.statement: The announcement came in Airbnb's Q3 2026 earnings shareholder letter.

claims.statement: The AI agent is meant to help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and assist during their stay.

sources.quote: Airbnb says its upcoming AI agent will help travelers plan trips, compare options, manage bookings, and get assistance throughout their stay.
